english.note: Use 網頁 specifically for an internet page rather than a physical page.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a single page on a website.

examples.english: This web page has all the registration information.
examples.traditional: 呢個網頁有齊報名資料。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 mong5 jip6 jau5 cai4 bou3 meng2 zi1 liu6
